feature_correspondence: additional supporting scientific claim (not one of the three headline domains)

SUPPORTED_requires_ALL.D: overall dimensionality domain at least directionally concordant
SUPPORTED_requires_ALL.E: overall alignment domain (A-C1/A-C2) at least directionally concordant
SUPPORTED_requires_ALL.F: no CENTRAL claim directionally opposite to the paper
SUPPORTED_requires_ALL.G: any unevaluated supporting claim does not materially undermine the headline conclusion
SUPPORTED_requires_ALL.note: a CENTRAL directionally-discordant claim AUTOMATICALLY blocks SUPPORTED

PARTIAL_requires.base: method sufficiently reconstructed AND >=1 headline domain concordant/directionally-concordant
and_one_or_more_of: an important supporting claim not evaluated
quantitative magnitudes differ materially despite directional agreement

NOT_SUPPORTED_requires.and: reconstructed findings fail the central scientific pattern broadly (prediction fails materially AND/OR both dimensional-compression AND reorientation directionally incompatible)
NOT_SUPPORTED_requires.note: one major discordant domain alone does NOT imply full NOT_SUPPORTED if other headline domains reproduce

PUBLIC_METHODS_INSUFFICIENT_requires.only_when: remaining public ambiguities materially prevent adjudication of the observed discrepancy
PUBLIC_METHODS_INSUFFICIENT_requires.forbidden_use: NOT to avoid a negative/mixed result when the method is sufficiently reconstructed and a claim genuinely disagrees
